caption: The drawing depicts a front view of a two-piece outfit consisting of a long-sleeved jacket and matching trousers in black linework on an off-white background. The jacket features a pointed collar, front button placket, and two small rectangular pockets on either side near the waist, both of which have scalloped edges. The jacket’s hem, sleeves, pocket flaps, front opening, and collar all have scalloped trim. The trousers have a single button at the waist, a front fly, and straight legs, with a scalloped edge along the outer seams and the bottoms of the pant legs. Both pieces are rendered without any shading or color, only using thin black lines. The drawing is centered on the page, with ample blank space surrounding the outfit.
title: Boy's Suit
